text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: As the three continued to climb the tower, so the attempts of Matsuri to recruit Hiyori continued.
text_block_list.orig_text: 塔を登りながらマツリによるヒヨリの勧誘は続いていた。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Eeehhh? So you really can't do it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えええ？　
やっぱりダメッスか？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: It's not that I "can't" do it... But if we're talking about me, it's just impossible.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ダメっていうか……
あたしにはやっぱり無理じゃないかなー
って。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: No such thing, pal. If you have a righteous sense of justice in your heart, then stand up!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなことないッスよ。
正義の心があるなら
立ち上がるべきッス！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Hmm, how about a role that helps you, Matsuri-chan, the actual Hero? Would that work?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うーん、
ヒーローであるマツリちゃんを助ける役、
ってのはダメかな？

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: You mean you want to play just a mere supporting role?
text_block_list.orig_text:
サポート役に徹する、
って
ことッスか？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Um, what was it called again... A side... punch?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えーと、
なんだっけ……
サイド……
パンチ？

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: If that's what you're going for, atleast know it's called a "sidekick"!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: それを言うならサイドキックッス！！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, sorry, my bad. This "sidekick" is supposed to help the hero, right? Wouldn't that do?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはは、
ごめんごめん。
その
サイドキックっていうのは
ヒーローのお手伝いをするんだよね？
それじゃあダメかな？

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Certainly, it's true that your supportive moves in the last battle were quite specialized, Hiyori-san. But are you sure you're okay with that?
text_block_list.orig_text:
確かに
ヒヨリさんのサポート能力は
さっきの戦いでよく分かったッスけど
本当にそれでいいッスか？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah, of course! I'll make sure to help you out a lot!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うんうん、
もっちろん！
いっぱいお手伝いしちゃうよ！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Well, if you say so, Hiyori-san... Alright.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあ、
ヒヨリさんがそこまでいうなら……
分かったッス。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, it's the third time, but... good to work with you, Matsuri-chan!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへ、
改めて
よろしくね、
マツリちゃん！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Sidekicks also have the side goal of being nurtured to become a proper hero, after all. From now on, you just need to develop the desire to become a hero!
text_block_list.orig_text:
サイドキックには
ヒーロー見習いって側面もあるッスからね。
これからヒーローになりたいって気持ちを育てていけばいいッス！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Leaving that aside, our priority right now is to help Kishi-kun regain his memories. We'll do our best to help him, so let's get fired UP!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
とにかく、
今は騎士くんの記憶を取り戻すお手伝いをするのが先決だよ。
がんばってお手伝いするから
はりきっていこー！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Got it, pal! Hmm... This presence!
text_block_list.orig_text:
分かったッス！
む……
この気配は！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: It's another monster! I'll provide you with proper support, so let's go, Matsuri-chan!
text_block_list.orig_text:
また魔物だ！
サポートはあたしがしっかりするから、
いくよ、
マツリちゃん！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me, pal! TEEEEEIYAAAA!
text_block_list.orig_text:
任せてほしいッス！
て
やー
ッス！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: You got it! Keep it up!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やったね！　
その調子！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Just how I like it, pal! Let's keep going!
text_block_list.orig_text:
調子いいッス！
このまま進んでいくッスよ！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: There's still more! Matsuri-chan!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まだまだいるよ！
マツリちゃん！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Leave those to me, pal! Here comes... THE HERO'S ATTACK!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
任せるッス！
これが、
ヒーローの一撃ッス！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Do it, Matsuri!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっちゃえ、
マツリちゃん！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Don't worry! I'm with you! Right there, Matsuri-chan!
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫！　
あたしがついてるもん！
そこだよ、
マツリちゃん！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Roger that, pal! Teyaaa!
text_block_list.orig_text:
了解ッス！
てやー！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Matsuri-chan, good work out there!
text_block_list.orig_text:
マツリちゃん、
お疲れさま。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: That was all thanks to your support, Hiyori-chan! You're so talented, it's kind of a shame for you to be a mere sidekick...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヒヨリさんのサポートのおかげッス！
サイドキックにしておくには
惜しい才能ッスよ……

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: But, I'm also starting to fit into the part myself! Let's keep climbing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
調子でてきたッス！
このまま登っていくッスよ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Matsuri-chan, it seems you're in top form yourself! Alright, I'll keep my support top-notch on my part, so I'm counting on you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
マツリちゃんも絶好調だね。
よ
ーし、
まだまだサポート頑張っちゃうから、
よろしくね！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me, pal! Once again, charge!
text_block_list.orig_text:
任せてほしいッス！
改めて、
突撃ッスー！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Thus, Matsuri and Hiyori, in top form, continued to climb the Tower of Luna together with {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうして、絶好調のマツリとヒヨリは
ルナの塔を登り続けるのであった。
